data.long_meaning: Asmahan is an Arabic name that means 'Gift of God'. It is a name that symbolizes the blessings and favors bestowed by Allah upon His children. The name Asmahan is derived from the Arabic word 'ism' meaning gift and 'mhan' meaning God. The name Asmahan carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Asmahan usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Asmahan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
